bundles.question: 如果活字印刷提前两百年普及到欧洲 / What if movable type spread across Europe two centuries earlier?

title.zh: 提前到来的印刷共和国

summary.zh: 知识复制成本提前下降，行会质量控制、大学开放网络与城邦大众政治形成三条可比较的制度路径。
summary.en: Cheaper copying arrives early, producing three comparable institutional paths: guild quality control, open university networks, and mass civic politics.

agents.name: 抄写员 / Scribe
agents.role: 文本校勘与印坊质量守门人 / Proofing and press quality keeper
agents.stance: 主张慢扩散、强校勘 / Favors controlled circulation and strict proofing

agents.name: 讲师 / Lecturer
agents.role: 跨城课程与学术交流组织者 / Organizer of intercity teaching and scholarship
agents.stance: 主张开放流通与公开辩论 / Favors open circulation and public debate

agents.name: 议员 / Councilor
agents.role: 城市议会与公共秩序代表 / Voice of the city council and civic order
agents.stance: 主张城市监督与可问责传播 / Favors civic oversight and accountable publishing

round1.content: 印得快不等于传得准，第一批印坊必须公开校勘规则。 / Faster printing does not guarantee cleaner knowledge; the first presses need public proofing rules.
同一份讲义跨城出现，学生和教师就能在同一问题上累积争论。 / Shared lectures let students and teachers build debate around the same questions across cities.
短册会把议会门外的人带进议题，但署名和更正也必须跟上。 / Pamphlets bring outsiders into civic debate, but attribution and corrections must keep pace.

outcomes.title: 行会印坊 / Guild Presses
outcomes.description: 印刷行会掌握准入、培训与校勘标准。 / Printing guilds control entry, training, and proofing standards.
outcomes.summary: 可靠文本缓慢扩散，政治变化受控。 / Reliable texts spread slowly and political change remains measured.
outcomes.story: 行会用共同字模、校勘章程和学徒制度降低错误率，同时限制匿名短册。识字率稳步上升，改革因传播门槛而保持渐进。 / Guilds reduce errors through shared type, proofing charters, and apprenticeships while restricting anonymous pamphlets. Literacy rises steadily and reform remains gradual.
outcomes.insight: 质量标准建立信任，却把新声音挡在高门槛之外。 / Quality standards build trust while keeping new voices behind a high barrier.

round2.content: 统一校样让跨城重印终于可核对，这是行会最强的公共价值。 / Standard proofs make intercity reprints verifiable, the guilds' strongest public value.
可靠不应等于封闭，大学需要为新作者保留快速通道。 / Reliability should not mean closure; universities need a fast lane for new authors.
只要章程公开且处罚可申诉，城市可以接受行会自治。 / Cities can accept guild self-rule if charters are public and penalties can be appealed.

round3.content: 错误率下降证明慢一点值得，但我同意公开申诉名册。 / Falling error rates justify the slower pace, and I accept a public appeals register.
被拒稿件仍在私下流通，过严准入正在制造另一套地下网络。 / Rejected texts still circulate privately; strict entry is creating an underground network.
行会同意季度公开更正后，议会获得了可检查的责任链。 / Quarterly correction rolls give the council an inspectable chain of responsibility.

outcomes.title: 大学网络 / University Network
outcomes.description: 大学以课程、译本和通信社群连接不同城市。 / Universities connect cities through courses, translations, and correspondence.
outcomes.summary: 知识扩散最快，争论也更频繁。 / Knowledge spreads fastest and disputes multiply with it.
outcomes.story: 大学联合发布课程版本并承认跨城学分，教师社群迅速形成。新理论得到早期检验，但宗教与政治争论也同步放大。 / Universities publish shared course editions and recognize study across cities. New theories are tested early, while religious and political disputes scale just as quickly.
outcomes.insight: 开放网络提高发现速度，也把协调成本推向制度前台。 / Open networks accelerate discovery and push coordination costs to the center of governance.

round2.content: 不同学院改动同一文本却不标版本，错误会披着学术自由的外衣扩散。 / Unmarked revisions let errors spread under the banner of academic freedom.
首个跨城书目已经让三所大学复现实验，开放正在产生回报。 / The first intercity catalog lets three universities replicate an experiment; openness is paying off.
城市愿意资助公共书库，但煽动性短册必须留下出版责任人。 / Cities will fund public libraries, but inflammatory pamphlets need accountable publishers.

round3.content: 版本号和勘误表被大学采用后，我愿意支持更开放的重印许可。 / With version numbers and errata adopted, I can support broader reprint licenses.
跨城评议把错误变成可见问题，而不是阻止传播的理由。 / Intercity review makes errors visible instead of using them as a reason to stop circulation.
争论速度已经超过议会回应速度，我们需要固定的公开答辩日。 / Debate now outruns council response, so we need scheduled public answer days.

outcomes.title: 城邦传单 / Civic Pamphlets
outcomes.description: 城市中的廉价短册推动大众参与和政治动员。 / Cheap civic pamphlets drive mass participation and political mobilization.
outcomes.summary: 公共参与提前扩大，治理波动明显上升。 / Public participation expands early and governance becomes markedly more volatile.
outcomes.story: 商贩、工匠和街区社群开始改写议会公告并公开回应。公共议程更包容，但谣言、派系动员和政策摇摆也更常见。 / Merchants, artisans, and neighborhoods rewrite council notices and answer them publicly. The agenda broadens, while rumors, factional mobilization, and policy swings become common.
outcomes.insight: 低门槛传播让权力更可见，也让信任更脆弱。 / Low-barrier publishing makes power more visible and trust more fragile.

round2.content: 伪造的议会公告已经出现，没有可追溯印记就无法维持公共信任。 / Forged council notices have appeared; public trust needs traceable press marks.
街区读书会让不识字者也能参与，知识不再只属于学院。 / Neighborhood readings include people who cannot read; knowledge no longer belongs only to colleges.
公开请愿迫使预算会议直播宣读，这是议会第一次真正面对城市多数。 / Public petitions force budget sessions into open readings, the council's first direct encounter with the city majority.

round3.content: 我支持普通人出版，但每份政治短册都应保留原版供人核验。 / I support popular publishing, but every political pamphlet should preserve an original for verification.
动员已压过讨论，我们必须训练主持人区分证据与口号。 / Mobilization is overtaking deliberation; facilitators must separate evidence from slogans.
即使政策更摇摆，公开回应已经不可逆，议会必须学会在透明中治理。 / Even with greater policy swings, public reply is irreversible; the council must learn to govern transparently.

report.headline: 行会印坊最可能稳定胜出，但大学网络提供更高的长期知识收益。 / Guild presses are the likeliest stable outcome, while the university network offers greater long-run knowledge gains.
report.confidence_basis: 三条路径的制度成本清晰可比，但大众政治的长期反馈仍高度不确定。 / Institutional costs are clearly comparable across the three paths, but long-run feedback from mass politics remains uncertain.

sections.intent: 解释校勘、开放评议与大众动员如何改变分支排序。 / Explain how proofing, open review, and mass mobilization change the branch ranking.

body.zh: 第一轮建立传播规则，第二轮暴露开放与可靠性的冲突，第三轮形成可问责出版这一共同底线。
body.en: Round one establishes circulation rules, round two exposes the conflict between openness and reliability, and round three converges on accountable publishing.

sections.intent: 比较行会、大学与议会分别如何管理传播风险。 / Compare how guilds, universities, and councils govern publishing risk.

body.zh: 行会以准入换可靠，大学以评议换速度，城邦以透明换参与；没有一条路径能同时最大化三者。
body.en: Guilds trade entry for reliability, universities trade review for speed, and cities trade transparency for participation; no path maximizes all three.

sections.intent: 识别封闭、失真与动员过热的早期信号。 / Identify early signs of closure, distortion, and overheated mobilization.

body.zh: 地下出版、无版本重印和伪造公告分别是三条路径最需要监测的失效模式。
body.en: Underground presses, unversioned reprints, and forged notices are the central failure modes to monitor across the three paths.

indicator.signal: 公开更正与版本标识的采用率 / Adoption of public corrections and version marks
indicator.note: 采用率上升意味着开放传播正在获得可靠性支撑。 / Rising adoption means open circulation is gaining a reliability layer.
indicator.threshold: 主要城市和大学均公开勘误记录 / Major cities and universities publish correction registers
indicator.observation: 观察重印本是否携带可核验版本号。 / Check whether reprints carry verifiable version numbers.
indicator.time_horizon: 未来两个出版周期 / Next two publishing cycles
indicator.rationale: 该信号同时回应三位角色对质量、开放与问责的核心关切。 / The signal addresses the three agents' core concerns about quality, openness, and accountability.

follow_ups: 谁应为跨城勘误记录提供长期资金？ / Who should fund intercity correction registers over time?
匿名政治短册应保留哪些最低问责信息？ / What minimum accountability should anonymous political pamphlets retain?
report.limitations: 推演压缩了宗教权威、战争和材料供应等外部冲击，概率仅表示三条叙事路径的相对权重。 / The simulation compresses external shocks such as religious authority, war, and material supply; probabilities express only relative narrative weight.

intervention.user_input: 要求大学采用统一版本号并公开勘误记录。 / Require universities to use common version numbers and publish errata.
intervention.effect: 开放网络保留传播速度，同时缓解抄写员对失真的担忧。 / The open network keeps its speed while reducing the scribe's concern about distortion.

bundles.question: 如果郑和比哥伦布先发现了美洲大陆 / What if Zheng He reached the Americas before Columbus?

summary.zh: 首次接触从太平洋一侧展开，港口互市、礼制外交和常驻据点形成稳定性、互惠性与扩张速度不同的三条路径。
summary.en: First contact begins from the Pacific, producing three paths with different balances of stability, reciprocity, and speed: harbor exchange, court diplomacy, and a permanent outpost.

agents.name: 航海官 / Navigator
agents.role: 航线、水文与船队安全规划者 / Planner of routes, coastal knowledge, and fleet safety
agents.stance: 主张谨慎接触与可撤回承诺 / Favors cautious contact and reversible commitments

agents.name: 译员 / Interpreter
agents.role: 语言、礼仪与条款协调者 / Mediator of language, ceremony, and terms
agents.stance: 主张对等解释与共同词表 / Favors reciprocal interpretation and shared vocabulary

agents.name: 市舶商 / Merchant
agents.role: 港口贸易与补给网络组织者 / Organizer of harbor trade and supply networks
agents.stance: 主张稳定互市与有限常驻 / Favors durable exchange and a limited permanent presence

round1.content: 先测水文、季风和补给距离，再决定接触规模。 / Chart currents, winds, and supply distances before deciding the scale of contact.
共同词表比武力更快建立信任，第一份协议必须让双方都能复述。 / A shared vocabulary builds trust faster than force; both sides must be able to restate the first agreement.
互市要从可替代的货物开始，不能让任何一方立刻依赖单一港口。 / Exchange should begin with replaceable goods so neither side immediately depends on one harbor.

outcomes.title: 港口联盟 / Harbor League
outcomes.description: 沿海城市以译员馆和季节性互市建立松散联盟。 / Coastal cities build a loose league around interpreters and seasonal exchange.
outcomes.summary: 冲突最低、扩散最慢，互惠关系最耐久。 / Conflict is lowest and diffusion slowest, producing the most durable reciprocity.
outcomes.story: 船队把接触限制在数个港口，双方共享航图、作物和医疗经验。内陆变化缓慢，但港口规则在多次航季后仍能被遵守。 / The fleet limits contact to several harbors, sharing charts, crops, and medical knowledge. Inland change is slow, but harbor rules endure across repeated sailing seasons.
outcomes.insight: 可撤回的小承诺比宏大宣言更容易累积跨文化信用。 / Small reversible commitments accumulate cross-cultural trust more reliably than grand declarations.

round2.content: 季节性航线让船队能在局势变化时撤回，安全边界仍然清楚。 / Seasonal routes let the fleet withdraw as conditions change, keeping safety boundaries clear.
译员馆开始记录双方误解，这比一次完美翻译更有价值。 / The interpreter house now records misunderstandings, which is more valuable than a single perfect translation.
多港轮换降低垄断风险，却让仓储和计量成本持续上升。 / Rotating among harbors lowers monopoly risk but keeps storage and measurement costs high.

round3.content: 共享航标减少了事故，我支持把联盟扩展到下一条海岸线。 / Shared navigation marks reduce accidents, so I support extending the league to the next coast.
互惠条款已能被双方公开复述，关系不再依赖单个译员。 / Both sides can publicly restate reciprocal terms, so the relationship no longer depends on one interpreter.
利润没有据点方案高，但低冲突让贸易连续性更可预测。 / Profits trail the outpost path, but low conflict makes continuity more predictable.

outcomes.title: 礼制使团 / Court Embassy
outcomes.description: 双方以正式使团、礼物与对等文书定义首次接触。 / Formal embassies, gifts, and reciprocal documents define the encounter.
outcomes.summary: 政治承认来得快，实际交流受礼制节奏约束。 / Political recognition arrives quickly while practical exchange follows a ceremonial pace.
outcomes.story: 译员把贡礼语言改写为对等承诺，双方宫廷迅速承认彼此。威望提高，但每次调整都要经过冗长礼仪，地方港口缺少自主空间。 / Interpreters recast tribute language as reciprocal commitments, winning rapid mutual recognition. Prestige rises, but every adjustment passes through lengthy ceremony and local harbors retain little autonomy.
outcomes.insight: 外交框架能稳定意义，却可能把现实问题变成礼仪排队。 / Diplomatic framing stabilizes meaning but can turn practical problems into ceremonial queues.

round2.content: 正式航书明确了安全港，但临时避风仍需层层请示。 / Formal sailing letters identify safe harbors, yet emergency shelter still requires layers of approval.
把贡礼改写成互赠后，双方终于在同一条款上点头。 / Recasting tribute as mutual gifts finally lets both sides assent to the same terms.
宫廷许可提升信誉，但货物在等待仪式时已经错过市场。 / Court approval raises credibility, but goods miss their market while ceremonies proceed.

round3.content: 若使团授权港口处理紧急情况，礼制与航海安全可以兼容。 / Ceremony can coexist with safety if embassies authorize harbors to handle emergencies.
对等文书成为共同记忆，但我担心地方声音仍未进入谈判。 / Reciprocal documents create shared memory, though local voices remain outside negotiation.
固定使团带来稳定订单，我仍要求缩短货物审批周期。 / Permanent embassies bring stable orders, but I still demand shorter cargo approvals.

outcomes.title: 远洋据点 / Ocean Outpost
outcomes.description: 船队把补给站扩成常驻工坊和贸易据点。 / A supply station grows into a permanent workshop and trading outpost.
outcomes.summary: 知识和货物流动最快，地方抵触与治理压力最高。 / Knowledge and goods move fastest, while local resistance and governance pressure peak.
outcomes.story: 常驻工坊快速交换造船、作物和金属技术，并吸引远距离商路。扩张速度超过协商能力，土地、劳役和司法争议让据点持续脆弱。 / A permanent workshop rapidly exchanges shipbuilding, crops, and metalworking and draws long-distance trade. Expansion outruns negotiation, leaving the outpost vulnerable to disputes over land, labor, and justice.
outcomes.insight: 高密度接触放大收益，也把每个未解决的不对称迅速政治化。 / Dense contact magnifies gains and rapidly politicizes every unresolved asymmetry.

round2.content: 补给站正在消耗原定返航储备，扩建速度已经越过安全线。 / The station is consuming return reserves; expansion has crossed the safety line.
工坊合同没有对应本地土地观念，误解正变成公开抵触。 / Workshop contracts do not match local ideas of land, and misunderstanding is becoming open resistance.
常驻仓库让交换量翻倍，但我们必须把收益分配写进协议。 / Permanent warehouses double exchange, but benefit sharing must be written into the agreement.

round3.content: 缩小防御圈并保留撤离航线后，据点才重新具备可控风险。 / The outpost becomes manageable only after shrinking its perimeter and preserving an evacuation route.
共同仲裁席首次让地方代表否决工坊扩建，冲突暂时降温。 / A joint arbitration seat lets local representatives veto expansion for the first time, cooling conflict.
让出扩建速度换来长期经营权，收益更慢却不再随一次冲突归零。 / Trading expansion speed for long-term operating rights slows gains but prevents one clash from erasing them.

report.headline: 港口联盟最可能形成耐久接触，礼制使团居次；常驻据点收益最高但风险也最集中。 / The harbor league is most likely to sustain contact, followed by court diplomacy; the outpost offers the greatest upside and the most concentrated risk.
report.confidence_basis: 三条路径在承诺可撤回性、地方参与和扩张速度上的差异稳定，但疾病与生态冲击未被完整建模。 / The paths differ consistently in reversibility, local participation, and expansion speed, while disease and ecological shocks remain under-modeled.

sections.intent: 比较季节互市、正式外交与常驻接触的承诺强度。 / Compare commitment intensity across seasonal exchange, formal diplomacy, and permanent contact.

body.zh: 港口联盟通过小步承诺积累信用，礼制使团用正式承认稳定关系，据点则一次性承担更高不可逆成本。
body.en: The harbor league compounds trust through small commitments, embassies stabilize relations through recognition, and the outpost assumes a much larger irreversible cost at once.

sections.intent: 说明共同词表和可复述条款为何决定冲突水平。 / Show why shared vocabulary and restatable terms determine conflict levels.

body.zh: 当协议能被双方公开复述时，误解可被修正；当合同只符合一方制度时，经济摩擦会迅速政治化。
body.en: When both sides can publicly restate an agreement, misunderstandings can be repaired; when contracts fit only one side's institutions, economic friction quickly becomes political.

sections.intent: 识别常驻活动越过协商能力的时点。 / Identify when permanent activity outruns negotiating capacity.

body.zh: 土地、劳役和司法争议同时出现，是扩张速度超过共同治理能力的明确信号。
body.en: Simultaneous disputes over land, labor, and justice are a clear sign that expansion has outrun shared governance.

indicator.signal: 双方可公开复述的共同条款数量 / Number of jointly restatable public terms
indicator.note: 共同条款增加意味着关系不再依赖少数中介。 / More shared terms mean the relationship depends less on a few intermediaries.
indicator.threshold: 港口、使团和地方代表均采用同一版本协议 / Harbors, embassies, and local representatives use the same agreement version
indicator.observation: 比较双方公告对权利、撤回和仲裁的表述。 / Compare both sides' public language on rights, withdrawal, and arbitration.
indicator.time_horizon: 未来三个航季 / Next three sailing seasons
indicator.rationale: 可复述条款直接衡量翻译是否转化为稳定制度。 / Restatable terms directly measure whether translation has become a stable institution.

follow_ups: 哪些交换品最适合作为低依赖的首批贸易？ / Which goods best support low-dependency early exchange?
地方代表应如何获得对据点扩建的否决权？ / How should local representatives gain veto power over outpost expansion?
report.limitations: 推演未完整表示疾病传播、人口冲击和跨洋生态交换，结论只比较所列制度路径。 / The simulation does not fully represent disease, demographic shocks, or transoceanic ecological exchange; conclusions compare only the listed institutional paths.

intervention.user_input: 把贡礼措辞改写为双方都能撤回的对等互赠条款。 / Reframe tribute language as reciprocal gifts that either side may withdraw from.
intervention.effect: 礼制使团保留正式承认，同时减少单向臣属解释。 / The embassy retains formal recognition while reducing one-sided interpretations of submission.

bundles.question: 如果古代河流城市先建立跨区域防洪协议 / What if ancient river cities formed an early regional flood pact?

summary.zh: 城市先共享水位记录，再在共同账本、联储粮仓和迁徙通道之间选择不同的韧性与公平路径。
summary.en: Cities first share river observations, then choose among a common ledger, shared granaries, and safe-passage corridors, each balancing resilience and fairness differently.

agents.name: 治水匠 / Engineer
agents.role: 堤坝、水位与工程协调者 / Coordinator of levees, gauges, and river works
agents.stance: 主张共享记录与可验证预警 / Favors shared records and verifiable warnings

agents.name: 仓吏 / Granary Keeper
agents.role: 粮食储备、借贷与配给管理者 / Manager of reserves, grain loans, and rationing
agents.stance: 主张明确偿还规则和谨慎调拨 / Favors explicit repayment rules and cautious allocation

agents.name: 盟约使 / Envoy
agents.role: 跨城承诺与争端协调者 / Mediator of intercity commitments and disputes
agents.stance: 主张持久盟约与最低救灾义务 / Favors a durable pact and minimum relief duties

round1.content: 同一套刻度比十封急信可靠，所有城市必须先统一水位标记。 / One shared scale beats ten urgent letters; every city must standardize river marks first.
借粮要写清归还季节和损耗，否则信任会比洪水退得更快。 / Grain loans need clear return seasons and loss rules, or trust will recede faster than the flood.
盟约必须先保证预警、过境和最低口粮，才有资格谈更大的联盟。 / The pact must first guarantee warnings, passage, and minimum rations before claiming a larger alliance.

outcomes.title: 水位账本 / River Ledger
outcomes.description: 城市公开统一刻度的水位、降雨和堤坝记录。 / Cities publish water, rainfall, and levee records on a common scale.
outcomes.summary: 共同事实降低猜疑，工程协作最稳定。 / Shared facts reduce suspicion and make engineering cooperation most stable.
outcomes.story: 各城每日抄录水位并交叉核验，上游预警开始被下游信任。工程决策更早、更协调，但没有粮食与安置承诺时，弱城仍承担较大损失。 / Cities record and cross-check daily water levels, making upstream warnings credible downstream. Engineering becomes earlier and coordinated, though weaker cities still bear losses without food or shelter commitments.
outcomes.insight: 共享测量能建立事实共同体，却不能自动分配救灾成本。 / Shared measurement creates a community of facts but does not automatically distribute relief costs.

round2.content: 统一水位碑让上游泄洪提前两日可见，堤坝队终于能共同排班。 / Common gauges reveal upstream releases two days early, allowing levee crews to coordinate shifts.
预警准确了，但账本没有说明哪座城应承担紧急粮食成本。 / Warnings are accurate, but the ledger does not say which city bears emergency grain costs.
共同数字让争议从真假转向责任，这是盟约可以处理的问题。 / Shared numbers move disputes from truth to responsibility, which the pact can actually negotiate.

round3.content: 三次预警都被复核后，我支持把维修记录也纳入公开账本。 / After three verified warnings, I support adding maintenance records to the public ledger.
按受益比例设立小额储备后，共同事实终于开始对应共同成本。 / A small benefit-based reserve finally links shared facts to shared costs.
公开账本让违约无处隐藏，盟约信用第一次可以被外城观察。 / The public ledger makes breaches visible, letting outside cities observe pact credibility for the first time.

outcomes.title: 联储粮仓 / Shared Granary
outcomes.description: 城市按洪水风险和收成共同储粮、借粮与归还。 / Cities pool, lend, and repay grain according to flood risk and harvests.
outcomes.summary: 直接提高生存韧性，但公平争议最持续。 / Survival resilience rises directly, while fairness disputes persist.
outcomes.story: 丰收城市先向受灾城市借出粮食，联盟避免了第一轮饥荒。随后关于贡献、损耗和偿还季节的争论成为盟约核心。 / Surplus cities lend grain to flooded neighbors, preventing the first famine. Debate over contributions, losses, and repayment seasons then becomes the pact's central struggle.
outcomes.insight: 共同储备把团结变成可计算义务，也让每次例外都成为政治争议。 / Shared reserves turn solidarity into measurable duties and every exception into a political dispute.

round2.content: 粮仓选址若忽略支流风险，一场局部洪水就会摧毁共同储备。 / A granary sited without tributary risk can lose the common reserve to one local flood.
首批借粮救下了下游城，但必须记录损耗而不是假装每粒粮都能归还。 / The first loan saves the downstream city, but losses must be recorded rather than pretending every grain returns.
贡献公式若只看人口，大城会认为自己被惩罚，弱城则仍得不到保障。 / A population-only formula makes large cities feel punished while leaving weak cities exposed.

round3.content: 分散三座粮仓并共享水位预警后，单点失效风险已经下降。 / Splitting reserves across three granaries and sharing warnings reduces single-point failure.
风险、收成和既往借贷共同计价后，归还规则终于能被多数城市接受。 / Pricing risk, harvests, and loan history together makes repayment acceptable to most cities.
争端仍多，但公开公式让谈判围绕参数而不是互相指责。 / Disputes remain, but a public formula turns blame into negotiation over parameters.

outcomes.title: 迁徙通道 / Safe Passage
outcomes.description: 城市承认洪水季临时过境、安置与返乡权。 / Cities recognize temporary passage, shelter, and return rights during floods.
outcomes.summary: 救人最快，承载城市的资源和政治压力最高。 / Lives are saved fastest, while host cities bear the greatest resource and political pressure.
outcomes.story: 标记道路和临时营地让大量居民避开洪峰，盟约获得最直观的公共支持。接纳城市随后面对粮价、治安和返乡安排的持续压力。 / Marked roads and temporary camps move many residents away from flood peaks, earning broad support. Host cities then face sustained pressure over food prices, order, and return arrangements.
outcomes.insight: 通行权把救灾置于边界之前，却要求接纳成本有明确分担机制。 / Passage rights put relief before borders but require an explicit way to share hosting costs.

round2.content: 两条高地道路避开洪峰，但营地排水不足会制造新的风险。 / Two upland roads avoid the flood peak, but poor camp drainage creates a new hazard.
临时人口让粮价急升，没有预置口粮就会把救援变成冲突。 / Temporary arrivals drive grain prices up; without prepositioned rations, relief will become conflict.
首批居民安全过境证明盟约有用，现在必须保证他们有权返乡。 / The first safe crossing proves the pact's value; now it must guarantee the right to return.

round3.content: 营地按水位预警分阶段开放后，道路和排水不再同时过载。 / Phased camp openings tied to river warnings prevent roads and drainage from overloading together.
接纳成本按人日结算并由联盟储备补贴后，粮价开始稳定。 / Per-person-day hosting credits backed by alliance reserves begin to stabilize grain prices.
返乡期限和财产登记写入盟约后，接纳城市不再担心临时义务永久化。 / Return deadlines and property records reassure host cities that temporary duties will not become permanent.

report.headline: 水位账本最可能成为盟约核心，联储粮仓提供更直接韧性，迁徙通道则以最高承载压力换取最快救援。 / The river ledger is most likely to anchor the pact, shared granaries provide more direct resilience, and safe passage buys faster relief at the highest hosting cost.
report.confidence_basis: 水位、储备和接纳成本形成清晰权衡，但长期气候变化与战争冲击未纳入。 / Water data, reserves, and hosting costs create a clear trade-off, while long-run climate shifts and warfare are not included.

sections.intent: 解释统一刻度如何把信息转化为跨城行动。 / Explain how a common scale turns information into coordinated action.

body.zh: 交叉核验的水位记录降低真假争论，让城市能更早协调泄洪、堤防和营地开放。
body.en: Cross-checked river records reduce disputes over truth and let cities coordinate releases, levees, and camp openings earlier.

sections.intent: 比较粮食借贷与接纳补贴如何分配救灾成本。 / Compare how grain loans and hosting credits distribute relief costs.

body.zh: 公开公式能把互相指责变成参数谈判，但任何公式都必须同时考虑风险、能力和既往贡献。
body.en: Public formulas turn blame into negotiation over parameters, but must account for risk, capacity, and prior contributions together.

sections.intent: 识别一次性合作转化为长期制度的条件。 / Identify when one-off cooperation becomes a durable institution.

body.zh: 当预警可核验、成本可计算、临时权利有终点时，城市更愿意在下一次洪水前继续履约。
body.en: Cities are more willing to comply before the next flood when warnings are verifiable, costs calculable, and temporary rights have clear endpoints.

indicator.signal: 跨城预警被按时确认的比例 / Share of intercity warnings acknowledged on time
indicator.note: 确认率上升表示共同账本正在转化为实际协调。 / A rising acknowledgement rate shows that the common ledger is becoming real coordination.
indicator.threshold: 连续三次预警在一个日周期内由全部成员确认 / All members acknowledge three consecutive warnings within one day cycle
indicator.observation: 比较预警时间、确认时间和实际堤防行动。 / Compare warning times, acknowledgement times, and actual levee actions.
indicator.time_horizon: 下一个完整洪水季 / Next full flood season
indicator.rationale: 及时确认同时检验数据可信度、行政响应和盟约意愿。 / Timely acknowledgement tests data credibility, administrative response, and willingness to honor the pact.

follow_ups: 共同储备应按风险、人口还是财政能力筹资？ / Should shared reserves be funded by risk, population, or fiscal capacity?
临时迁徙权如何在洪水结束后公平终止？ / How should temporary passage rights end fairly after floodwaters recede?
report.limitations: 推演没有纳入长期河道改道、战争和多季歉收，概率只比较三种合作制度的叙事可行性。 / The simulation excludes long-term river shifts, warfare, and multi-season crop failure; probabilities compare only the narrative viability of the three cooperative institutions.

intervention.user_input: 把粮食损耗、风险和既往贡献同时写入公开偿还公式。 / Put losses, risk, and prior contributions into one public repayment formula.
intervention.effect: 争端从互相指责转向可审议参数，联储粮仓的可接受度提高。 / Disputes shift from blame to negotiable parameters, increasing acceptance of the shared granary.
